scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p device-tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 eslint packages scripts device-tests '*.{js,ts}' && prettier --check packages scripts device-tests docs ios .github '*.{md,json,js,ts,yaml,yml}'
scripts.format: prettier --write packages scripts device-tests docs ios .github '*.{md,json,js,ts,yaml,yml}'
scripts.ci: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
